sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Remote work and the junior employee
passage.text: When firms first sent employees home in 2020, many managers predicted a collapse in output. The collapse never came. Studies covering tens of thousands of workers found that routine tasks were completed slightly faster at home, largely because commutes disappeared and meetings shrank. Yet the same studies reported a quieter problem: employees in their first two years of work learned more slowly. Sitting near experienced colleagues, they had absorbed judgement by watching it being exercised. Video calls transmit information but not atmosphere, and a junior hire who does not know what to ask cannot ask it. Some firms now answer with hybrid weeks in which teams gather for the tasks that require judgement and disperse for the tasks that require concentration.

sections.name: 翻译
sections.note: 本题 12 分。把划线句子译成汉语，要求准确、通顺。

items.stem: Sitting near experienced colleagues, they had absorbed judgement by watching it being exercised.

answer.text: 坐在有经验的同事身边，他们通过观察判断力如何被运用而习得了这种判断力。

explain.right: 先切分意群定主干，再按汉语习惯重排语序，最后检查术语与指代是否统一。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：现在分词状语前置译成「坐在……身边」；被动 being exercised 转成汉语主动「如何被运用」；absorb 译「习得」比「吸收」更贴切。

walkthrough.solution:
参考译文：坐在有经验的同事身边，他们通过观察判断力如何被运用而习得了这种判断力。
得分点：现在分词状语前置译成「坐在……身边」；被动 being exercised 转成汉语主动「如何被运用」；absorb 译「习得」比「吸收」更贴切。
检查清单：主干是否译出、修饰是否归位、指代是否还原。

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 160 words based on the following idea: some companies now ask employees to return to the office for part of the week. Describe the trend, explain its reasons, and give your comment.

answer.text: A growing number of firms are asking staff to return to the office for two or three days a week. The shift is driven by two concerns. First, new employees learn judgement by observing experienced colleagues, and a screen transmits information far better than atmosphere. Second, some tasks, such as negotiating a contract or resolving a conflict, move faster when people share a room. Yet a full return would waste the hours that remote work has saved. The sensible arrangement is therefore deliberate: gather for the work that needs judgement, disperse for the work that needs concentration. Companies that treat the office as a tool rather than a habit are likely to keep both productivity and loyalty.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：没有点明「混合办公」这一核心概念，只泛泛谈效率；或只描述现象不分析原因。

framework.title: 图画作文
steps: 首段：一句点图（As is vividly depicted…），再写 2 句细节
二段：一句点寓意，再展开因果或举例
三段：一句总结 + 一句建议/展望
用具体名词替换万能词（people→students/employees）
framework.trap: 只描述图画不解释寓意，二段空洞

The sensible arrangement is therefore deliberate: gather for the work that needs judgement, disperse for the work that needs concentration. Companies that treat the office as a tool rather than a habit are likely to keep both productivity and loyalty.
